name: code-reviewer
description: Read-only code review for diffs, current code, and project-specific risks.

interface.shortDescription: Review diffs and current code without editing files.
interface.longDescription: Code Reviewer adds a reusable read-only reviewer skill and slash command for uncommitted diffs, selected files, full projects, and project-aware checks for Flutter, native mobile, web, and backend code.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review the current code or uncommitted diff with Code Reviewer.
